sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

assessment.adaptation: We follow the planned opening: one complete full-coverage term sheet at the current price, using the should-cost evidence card.
assessment.next_move: Propose EUR 29.89, 23,400/year, 24 months and 56 days. If a counter falls short of the target, follow with EUR 30.90 for 36 months and 56 days, citing the delivery-record evidence.

evidence.claim: The opening quotation offers 19,890/year. That is below the 22,230/year must-have, so it is not eligible for acceptance.
The supplier says it will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. That makes a binding full-volume, multi-year package our main lever.
Our buyer should-cost estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% confidence. It is not a proven supplier floor.
Supplier-wide on-time delivery was 79.5% in the rolling 2026Q3 scorecard, against a contractual 95% target. This figure covers all parts, not only this seal.
According to our 2026 meeting note, the supplier said price changes above 2% need approval from its pricing committee. Escalation or sponsorship may therefore matter.
The current contract price has been EUR 29.89/unit since 2024.
